create_stable_diffusion_3_image: create a StableDiffusion3Pipeline to generate images from text prompts with configurable guidance scale and inference steps
run_stable_diffusion_3_pipeline: run the StableDiffusion3Pipeline __call__ method to denoise latent variables and decode image outputs via VAE
encode_stable_diffusion_3_prompt: encode text prompts using CLIP and T5 text encoders with classifier-free guidance and LoRA scaling support
prepare_stable_diffusion_3_latents: prepare random Gaussian latents with configurable batch size, height, width, and dtype for diffusion denoising
retrieve_stable_diffusion_3_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler with custom num_inference_steps or custom timesteps list
